import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import h5py
import mne
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from statsmodels.regression.mixed_linear_model import MixedLM

# Parameters
epoch_tmin, epoch_tmax = -0.5, 0.5  # seconds
baseline = (-0.5, -0.3)
freqs = np.linspace(15, 25, 5)
n_cycles = freqs / 2.0  # cycles

# Containers for averaged epochs and metadata
epochs_list = []  # list of 1D arrays (n_times)
records = []

for sess in range(1, 11):
    # Load events
    ev = pd.read_csv(f'sub-0_ses-{sess}_events.tsv', sep='\t')
    ev = ev.sort_values('timemeg').reset_index(drop=True)
    ev['sentence_id'] = ev['sentenceidx'].apply(lambda x: f'sess{sess}_sen{x}')
    # Identify word-onset phonemes
    mask = (ev['kind'] == 'phoneme') & (ev['phonemeidx'] == 1)
    word_ph = ev[mask].copy().reset_index(drop=True)
    # Compute preceding pause durations
    pauses = []
    for i in word_ph.index:
        if i > 0 and ev.loc[i-1, 'kind'] == 'silence':
            pauses.append(ev.loc[i-1, 'duration'])
        else:
            pauses.append(0.0)
    word_ph['pause_dur'] = pauses

    # Load MEG data
    with h5py.File(f'sub-0_ses-{sess}_meg.h5', 'r') as f:
        data = f['data'][:]       # (306, n_times)
        times = f['times'][:]
        sfreq = f.attrs['sample_frequency']
        ch_types = f.attrs['channel_types'].split(',')
    grad_idx = [i for i, t in enumerate(ch_types) if t.strip() == 'grad']

    # Epoch extraction parameters
    off_pre = int(-epoch_tmin * sfreq)
    n_times = int((epoch_tmax - epoch_tmin) * sfreq)

    # Extract epochs averaged across grad channels
    for _, row in word_ph.iterrows():
        t0 = row['timemeg']
        center = np.searchsorted(times, t0)
        start = center - off_pre
        stop = start + n_times
        if start < 0 or stop > len(times):
            continue
        epoch = data[grad_idx, start:stop].mean(axis=0)
        epochs_list.append(epoch)
        records.append({
            'session': sess,
            'sentence_id': row['sentence_id'],
            'pause_dur': row['pause_dur']
        })

# Assemble epochs array and DataFrame
epochs = np.stack(epochs_list, axis=0)  # (n_epochs, n_times)
df = pd.DataFrame(records)
print(f"Total epochs extracted: {len(df)}")

# Reshape for TFR: treat averaged channel as single channel
epochs_tfr = epochs[:, np.newaxis, :]  # (n_epochs, 1, n_times)

# Compute TFR power
power = mne.time_frequency.tfr_array_morlet(
    epochs_tfr, sfreq=sfreq, freqs=freqs, n_cycles=n_cycles,
    output='power', decim=1
)  # (n_epochs, 1, n_freqs, n_times)
power = power[:, 0]  # collapse channel -> (n_epochs, n_freqs, n_times)

# Time vector and indices
times_vec = np.linspace(epoch_tmin, epoch_tmax, power.shape[2], endpoint=False)
bl_idx = np.where((times_vec >= baseline[0]) & (times_vec < baseline[1]))[0]
post_idx = np.where((times_vec >= 0) & (times_vec <= 0.3))[0]

# Baseline-correct and compute relative power change per epoch
rel_tf = (power - power[:, :, bl_idx].mean(axis=2, keepdims=True)) / \
         power[:, :, bl_idx].mean(axis=2, keepdims=True)
# Average across freqs then time windows
beta_change = rel_tf.mean(axis=1)[:, post_idx].mean(axis=1)

df['beta_change'] = beta_change

# Time-frequency plots for short vs long pauses
durs = df['pause_dur'].values
q1, q3 = np.percentile(durs, [25, 75])
short_idx = np.where(durs <= q1)[0]
long_idx = np.where(durs >= q3)[0]
avg_short = rel_tf[short_idx].mean(axis=0)  # (n_freqs, n_times)
avg_long = rel_tf[long_idx].mean(axis=0)

# Plot TF contrasts
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4))
for ax, avg, title in zip(axes, [avg_short, avg_long], ['Short pauses', 'Long pauses']):
    im = ax.pcolormesh(times_vec, freqs, avg, shading='auto', cmap='RdBu_r')
    ax.axvline(0, color='k', linestyle='--')
    ax.set_title(title)
    ax.set_xlabel('Time (s)')
    ax.set_ylabel('Frequency (Hz)')
    fig.colorbar(im, ax=ax)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# Mixed-effects model
md = MixedLM.from_formula('beta_change ~ pause_dur', df,
                          groups='session',
                          vc_formula={'sentence': '0 + C(sentence_id)'})
mdf = md.fit(reml=False)
print(mdf.summary())

# Scatter plot with regression line
plt.figure(figsize=(6, 4))
plt.scatter(df['pause_dur'], df['beta_change'], alpha=0.3)
coef, intercept = np.polyfit(df['pause_dur'], df['beta_change'], 1)
xp = np.linspace(df['pause_dur'].min(), df['pause_dur'].max(), 100)
plt.plot(xp, coef * xp + intercept, 'r-', linewidth=2)
plt.xlabel('Pause duration (s)')
plt.ylabel('Beta power change (rel.)')
plt.title('Beta desynchronization vs pause length')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
